note: 结构模块（墙/楼梯/门框）不进本批：按 asset-model-workflow 规则走 Vibe3D/本地 Blender。本批只做雕塑/有机类道具。

props.name: 古老女神像
props.prompt: Create a clean orthographic three-view modeling reference sheet of a single ancient weathered stone goddess statue videogame prop. A robed female figure carved in pale grey limestone, arms gently open in a blessing gesture, serene calm face, two dull blue sapphire eyes set into the head, a small teardrop-shaped crystal at her chest glowing faintly milky white, standing on a square stone pedestal base carved with faint worn runes. Weathered pitted stone surface, thin moss traces in crevices, chipped edges, no arms broken off. Arrange EXACTLY THREE equal-width separate panels horizontally on a perfectly flat pure white background, with no panel borders: left panel exact orthographic FRONT view; middle panel exact orthographic LEFT SIDE view; right panel exact orthographic BACK view. These are three rotations of ONE IDENTICAL object with matching dimensions and features, not three alternatives. All three upright, same height and same top and bottom baseline, centered in each third with ample blank margins, NO perspective, NO isometric, NO cast shadows, NO ground plane, NO text or labels. Even studio lighting that clearly exposes the stone surface, no crushed-black regions, no background gradients. Faithful crisp PBR-style modeling reference. Landscape 1536x1024 image.
